en.title: Marvel Tokon DLC Adds Jane Foster Thor, Venom, and Jubilee in 2027
en.summary: Arc System Works has detailed the remaining Year 1 DLC for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls. Jane Foster Thor, Venom, and Jubilee are confirmed to join the roster in 2027.
en.body:
Arc System Works has officially unveiled the full slate of upcoming downloadable content for **Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls**, confirming that fan-favorite characters **Jane Foster Thor**, **Venom**, and **Jubilee** will be joining the roster in 2027. This announcement, made during Evo France 2026, provides a clear roadmap for the game's first year of post-launch content, aiming to keep players engaged with fresh additions.

Following the release of **Phoenix Cyclops** on November 2, 2026, the first new fighter to arrive will be **Jane Foster Thor**. She is slated for a winter 2027 release, with a brief teaser showcasing her model within Odin's Vault hinting at potential confrontations with Loki. While a full gameplay trailer is expected at a later date, the developer has confirmed her arrival window before March 2027. Despite some market concerns, the studio is committed to delivering more content, with **Venom** set to debut in spring 2027, and the explosive **Jubilee** following in the summer of the same year. Unlike the more unique iterations of Cyclops and Thor, Venom and Jubilee appear to be more straightforward interpretations, promising to integrate seamlessly into the game's tag-team mechanics alongside existing characters like **Doctor Doom**, **Iron Man**, and **Magneto**.

## A Feast for Fighting Game Fans

The addition of these iconic Marvel characters is a significant move for **Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls**. **Jane Foster Thor** brings her unique take on the God of Thunder, offering a distinct playstyle and visual flair. The inclusion of **Venom**, a perennial fan-favorite anti-hero, promises to inject a dose of symbiote-fueled chaos into the roster. Meanwhile, **Jubilee** represents the vibrant and energetic side of the X-Men, known for her dazzling fireworks-based powers. The developer has also confirmed that **Venom** will come with a new stage set on the Symbiote homeworld of Klyntar, adding further value to the Year 1 Character and Stage Pass, which is priced at $34.99. This move signals Arc System Works' dedication to supporting the game long-term and building a robust community around its unique blend of Marvel IP and signature fighting game expertise.

## What's Next for Marvel Tokon

With **Jane Foster Thor** arriving in winter 2027, **Venom** in spring 2027, and **Jubilee** in summer 2027, players have plenty to look forward to. While specific release dates for Venom and Jubilee have not yet been announced, the seasonal windows provide a clear timeline. Fans eager to see these new combatants in action will be keeping a close eye on future announcements for gameplay trailers and precise launch dates, ensuring they are ready to jump into the fray as soon as these characters become available.

content_raw: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls will continue its Year 1 DLC roadmap with Thor (Jane Foster) this winter, with two more characters coming in 2027. Developer Arc System Works confirmed the lineup alongside Evo France 2026. The Jane Foster version of Asgard's God of Thunder is now officially set to follow Phoenix Cyclops after he releases November 2, 2026, with today's announcement coming with both a sneak peek at her Marvel Tokon model in Odin's Vault on Asgard. The clip doesn't show too much, only teasing that we'll probably see Jane fight off Loki while wielding Mjolnir when a proper gameplay trailer premieres at a later date. Arc System Works said she's scheduled to launch in Marvel Tokon "winter 2027," so expect to see her arrival sometime before March of next year. Despite some concerns from players that poor sales could jeopardize the Marvel fighting game's future, at least two more characters will arrive in spring and summer 2027, too. Yes, Spider-Man anti-hero and Symbiote menace Venom will finally join the roster in spring 2027. X-Men firecracker Jubilee will then follow in the summer of that year. While Cyclops and Thor are entering the fray as relatively lesser-known versions of themselves, Venom and Jubilee appear to be mostly straightforward. That means Marvel Tokon players will get to see them fight the rest of the tag-team fighting with and against the game's roster – which includes characters like Doctor Doom, Iron Man, Carnage, Magneto, and more – in Arc System Works' heightened style. Although the details surrounding each DLC release are unclear, the reveal trailer did at least confirm that Venom will also come with a stage based on the Symbiote home world of Klyntar. It's all part of the Year 1 Character and Stage Pass, which costs $34.99. A roadmap with some of the most beloved characters from Marvel history would usually be enough to have comic book and video game fans frothing at the mouth, but uncertainty surrounding the project might have some looking at the Evo announcement in a different light. Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls launched to strong reviews (a 9/10 from IGN) in August, but at least on PC, players have struggled. Its Steam launch brought mixed reviews from fans who complained of widespread technical issues and PlayStation Network requirements. Even as the developers almost immediately promised to investigate the issues, it didn't take long for the backlash to swell to the point that famed fighting game community member Maximilian Dood wrote off playing the PC version altogether . It only took a few days for Arc System Works to push out a fix for most players' issues , but as Steam player numbers still struggle to break even 1,000 concurrent users (via SteamDB ), even the developers have admitted earning back trust will be "extremely challenging."
